activity.notes: John I (Jan I) was recognized as Duke of Brabant in 1267 after Henry IV's abdication. DBNL records his Brabant dukedom from 1267 and his death on 3 May 1294. He also acquired Limburg after 1288, but this Activity models the requested Duchy of Brabant.

sources.title: Jan I — Nieuw Nederlandsch biografisch woordenboek, DBNL
sources.citation_text: DBNL records Jan I as Duke of Brabant from 1267, Duke of Brabant and Limburg after 1288, and gives his death on 3 May 1294.

sources.title: John the Victorious — Numista ruler catalogue
sources.citation_text: Numismatic catalogue references John I as Duke of Brabant for 1267–1294 and documents coins bearing the ducal Brabant title.
